name: SpotScribe
tagline: SpotScribe is a Spotify podcast transcript generator designed to turn any podcast into text instantly
description: SpotScribe is a Spotify podcast transcript generator designed to turn any podcast into text instantly. By simply pasting a Spotify episode URL, users can extract high-accuracy transcripts without the need for complex setups or software downloads. This streamlined process allows for quick access to spoken content in a readable format.
